The line joining the centres is perpendicular to the common chord and bisects it, so each half of chord \(PQ\) is \(8/2=4\) cm. The chord lies between the centres, so the two distances from the centres to the chord add to give \(AB\).

For the circle with centre \(A\):
\[
d_A=\sqrt{7^2-4^2}=\sqrt{33}\text{ cm}.
\]
For the circle with centre \(B\):
\[
d_B=\sqrt{10^2-4^2}=\sqrt{84}=2\sqrt{21}\text{ cm}.
\]
Therefore,
\[
\boxed{AB=\sqrt{33}+2\sqrt{21}\text{ cm}\approx 14.9\text{ cm}.}
\]
